dedupe_keys.name: dhcsim modelica library for dynamic simulation of district heating and cooling networks extension of the modelica buildings library

description: dhcSim is a free, open-source Modelica library with basic models for dynamic simulation of complex district heating and cooling (DHC) networks, documented on the OpenModelica build server (documentation version 1, using Buildings 9.0.0, Modelica 3.2.3 and dhcSim 5.0.1). It extends the Modelica Buildings Library and was developed to ease modelling of DHC systems from two-level concepts of supply and return up to many parallel network levels, with a simple and clear model structure that is user-friendly and applicable to many custom network concepts, for small and significantly larger networks. The contents list packages of DHC components and fluid models, and the page welcomes contributions such as model development, use, testing, requirements and feedback. Coverage is generic networks, not a specific site. Access: online documentation, free; the code repository and licence name are not given on the page read. Caveats: the page is library documentation without validation cases. It suits design and operation studies of heat and cold networks, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
